title: The Viking Portrait: getting helmets, braids, and gear right
excerpt: Vikings didn't wear horned helmets. Here's what they actually wore, how to braid the hair, and how to brief a Norse commission that lands historically.
seo_title: Viking Character Portrait Commission: Period-Accurate Guide
seo_description: Period-correct Viking portraits: real Norse helmets, braids, wool kit, axes, and what the Vikings TV show gets wrong. A briefing guide.
